turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: From 17 August to 10 October 2026, the average order value (EUR) was 102.67 EUR for customers who signed up before 2026 (all of them signed up in 2024) and 41.00 EUR for customers who signed up in 2026; the semantic layer has no metric for the gap itself, so these are the two figures to compare.
